title: Implement goal evaluator interface
objective: Add the GoalEvaluator interface and a provider-backed implementation seam without wiring automatic continuation yet.
context: The first implementation can be an interface plus fake-friendly adapter. Full small-model selection can be follow-up configuration.
The loop should later depend on this interface, not directly on a concrete provider.

source_evidence.note: Claude defaults evaluator to a small fast model, but keeps it transcript-only.

include: Optional provider-backed adapter skeleton if the provider API is straightforward.
exclude: No model catalog changes unless already required by tests.

implementation_steps: Implement the interface and request/result structs.
Add helper text for evaluator prompt if needed.
deliverables: GoalEvaluator interface and test-passing implementation seam.
acceptance_criteria: The evaluator request has no tool registry, filesystem, or command runner.
The implementation can be faked in loop tests.
risks: Choosing a specific small model too early can make provider configuration brittle.
dispatch_prompt: Implement the GoalEvaluator interface and supporting types to satisfy loop/goal_evaluator_test.go. Keep it transcript-only and fake-friendly; do not wire continuation yet.
notes_for_assignee: If provider-backed evaluation is not obvious in 5 minutes, add the interface plus TODO-free fake seam and leave concrete selection for a later task.
